name: Trailblazer Acquisition Corp. Unit
summary: These units offer an investment in Trailblazer Acquisition Corp., a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC). Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant, with full warrants allowing for the purchase of a share at $11.50. This SPAC aims to complete mergers within the media, communications, sports, entertainment, technology, and consumer retail industries.
